main_text.head: DE VERBIS CONTRACTIS.

page.notes: Greek paradigm forms are partly worn and some accents are uncertain; the Greek is copied as far as legible, with ellipses standing for words I could not read reliably. Left-margin labels are not notes but paradigm headings. The catchword "INDI-" at the foot is a catchword, not a paragraph. The Greek and Latin in the running text are transcribed approximately from the scan.
